records.source: The projected lasso. Unlike :class:`PrismGate` nothing about it is tied to one of the three axis planes.

records.translation: 投影套索。用户将体数据旋转到能够分开某个群体的任意角度，然后在屏幕上围绕它绘制；该门控就是在该视图上的“投影”落在轮廓内部的所有对象——即无论角度如何，都将轮廓沿直线向后扫过整个体数据。与 :class:`PrismGate` 不同，它与三个轴平面中的任何一个都没有关联。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ViewGate#2
records.source: THE VIEW IS PART OF THE GATE. An outline on the screen means nothing without the camera it was drawn through, so the gate carries the camera as ``projection``: a 4 x 4 matrix taking a measurement ``(x, y, z, 1)`` to homogeneous view coordinates ``(sx, sy, depth, sw)``, scaled so that ``sw`` is positive in front of the camera. The outline lives in ``(sx / sw, sy / sw)``. Rows one, two and four are the whole of what :meth:`mask` needs, so re-applying a saved gate needs no plotting library and gives the same answer on any machine; the depth row only lets the outline be drawn back into the volume from another angle.
records.context: The view is part of the data-selection boundary. An outline on the screen means nothing without the camera it was drawn through, so the data-selection boundary carries the camera as ``projection``: a 4 x 4 matrix taking a measurement ``(x, y, z, 1)`` to homogeneous view coordinates ``(sx, sy, depth, sw)``, scaled so that ``sw`` is positive in front of the camera. The outline lives in ``(sx / sw, sy / sw)``. Rows one, two and four are the whole of what :meth:`mask` needs, so re-applying a saved data-selection boundary needs no plotting library and gives the same answer on any machine; the depth row only lets the outline be drawn back into the volume from another angle.
records.translation: “视图是门控的一部分。”屏幕上的轮廓如果没有绘制时所用的相机就毫无意义，因此门控以 ``projection`` 的形式携带相机：一个 4 x 4 矩阵，将测量值 ``(x, y, z, 1)`` 映射到齐次视图坐标 ``(sx, sy, depth, sw)``，并经过缩放使 ``sw`` 在相机前方为正。轮廓位于 ``(sx / sw, sy / sw)`` 中。第一、二、四行就是 :meth:`mask` 所需的全部内容，因此重新应用已保存的门控不需要任何绘图库，并且在任何机器上都得到相同的结果；深度行只是让轮廓可以从另一个角度重新绘制回体数据中。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

Nothing here opens a socket: the panel only asks, and a fetch that fails, is rate-limited, is switched off in Preferences, or simply finds nothing newer leaves the bundled list exactly as it was drawn.
